hook: Foaming photopolymers enable 20,000 dpi inkless printing
what_happened: Researchers used UV‑A light to trigger foaming in a polymer film, creating controlled pores and a white, high‑resolution pattern
why_it_matters: It removes the need for ink and enables micron-scale printing of optical and wetting features
the_catch: So far it's only been demonstrated on amorphous and semi-crystalline polymers
caption: New foam‑based photolithography prints at 20,000 dpi without ink – a step toward bio‑inspired, high‑resolution manufacturing
alt_text: A five‑slide carousel explaining how UV‑induced foaming in photopolymers creates high‑resolution, inkless printing, highlighting the process, benefits, and limitations

es.hook: Los fotopolímeros espumantes permiten impresión sin tinta a 20,000 dpi
es.what_happened: Los investigadores usaron luz UV‑A para provocar la espumación en una película de polímero, creando poros controlados y un patrón blanco de alta resolución
es.why_it_matters: Elimina la necesidad de tinta y permite la impresión a escala de micrones de características ópticas y de humectación
es.the_catch: Hasta ahora solo se ha demostrado en polímeros amorfos y semicristalinos
